valid_fixes: Add kinesis:GetShardIterator back to the FirehoseRole kinesis action list in the first Statement entry
invalid_patches: Adding kinesis:GetShardIterator to the Elasticsearch statement instead of the Kinesis statement
Granting kinesis:* wildcard instead of the specific required actions
Adding the action to LambdaRole instead of FirehoseRole
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_invoke_lambda(FunctionName=IngestFunction, Payload={movie document}) → 200 success, confirming ingest path works
ace_describe_firehose_stream(DeliveryStreamName=IngestFirehoseStream) → ACTIVE status, KinesisStreamAsSource, no obvious configuration error
ace_get_metric_statistics(Namespace=AWS/Firehose, MetricName=DeliveryToElasticsearch.Records, DeliveryStreamName=IngestFirehoseStream) → value 0, confirming Firehose delivers nothing to Elasticsearch
ace_get_iam_role(RoleName=FirehoseRole) → kinesis action list contains DescribeStream, GetRecords, ListShards but is missing GetShardIterator
observable_symptom: The ingest endpoint accepts movie documents and returns 200. Records accumulate in the data stream (stream shows active status and incoming records). The streaming delivery pipeline reports active status with a Kinesis source, but no records are delivered to the search index — the delivery metric for records reaching the search index is zero for the entire observation window. Searching returns no results.
root_cause: The FirehoseRole kinesis action list is missing kinesis:GetShardIterator. The Firehose delivery service calls GetShardIterator to obtain a shard cursor before calling GetRecords to read data. Without GetShardIterator permission, the internal polling loop cannot advance past the cursor step and silently delivers nothing to Elasticsearch.
